summary: The remediated browser check shows Spellweavers Run 2D started and accepted two player actions with all four built-ins absent. The screenshots show an input-driven game change, and the no-input probe rejects clock-only changes.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: The Phaser 2D game has an empty accessibility snapshot because the interface renders in a canvas. The screenshots show game content, but the canvas does not expose that content to assistive technology. This remains a nonblocking limitation.
evidence: The audited HEAD is ad56865ba45daf5cf9d9c2557497a49f20c733ba, which green-p3-t7r.log records as the final Green HEAD after remediation c3f48a52.

Read out/old-browser/check.json: game is spellweavers-run; started is true; moves is 2; action_inputs are ArrowRight and 1; state_changed is true; errors is empty; all four built-ins are undefined in the page.
Read scripts/old-browser-check.mjs. It deletes the four built-ins before navigation, asserts their absence, selects the game, starts the Phaser renderer, and requires a mounted game.

The remediated acceptedAction rule compares player-action state fields: word, collected, score, courage, roundId, and chosen. Clock fields do not contribute to the move count. At least one accepted transition is required.

Read probe-p3r1-no-input.mjs. It blocks keyboard events and exercises the check without player key actions. green-p3-t7r.log records its expected failure: zero accepted moves even though the general state digest changed with time. This shows clock-only change cannot satisfy the move gate.
Read probe-p3r1-write-fail.mjs and probe-p3r1-collision.mjs. They exercise report-write failure and an occupied-port collision; green-p3-t7r.log records expected failures and cleanup.

Opened the start and move screenshots. The start image shows the Spellweavers Run question, choices, HUD, scene, and player. The move image shows a word marked in the sentence and a changed progress state.
The script URL is http://127.0.0.1:5199/demo/index.html?qc=1&renderer=phaser and the selected game id is spellweavers-run.
green-p3-t7r.log reports exit 0, empty errors, and no listener on port 5199 after the run.
The Phaser accessibility tree remains empty. The screenshots establish the shown game states only; no broader visual-quality or audible-quality claim is made.

interactions: Advanced through the story reader and briefing, then started the Phaser game with all four built-ins deleted.
